event_summary: A set of shiny hanging balls starts still, then the end balls alternately move outward to the left and right while the middle balls remain mostly grouped.
raw_event_description: The video shows a tabletop apparatus with a chrome-colored frame, a black base, and five shiny suspended balls initially aligned in a close horizontal row. For many frames the apparatus and balls appear still. Later, a left-side ball is visible displaced outward and then comes back toward the row; afterward a right-side ball moves outward to the right. The motion repeats with the left and right end balls alternately separated from the row and returning, while the central balls remain close together near the center. The clip ends while a right-side ball is still visibly separated to the right.

reasons: The frame, base, strings, and five shiny balls are visible.
The balls are initially aligned in a close row.
No visible object motion is present in the first frame.

evidence_bank.observation: Five shiny spheres are aligned in a close horizontal row near the lower center of the apparatus.
Thin vertical lines connect the shiny spheres to the upper part of the chrome-colored frame.
The black rectangular base is on a light-brown tabletop.
A blue-and-black object lies on the tabletop to the left of the apparatus.
The balls remain visibly still for an initial interval.
A shiny ball is visible separated to the left of the central row.
The left separated ball moves back toward the row.
A shiny ball on the right side moves outward and becomes separated from the row.
The middle balls remain close together near the center while an end ball is separated.
The right separated ball moves back toward the row.
A shiny ball on the left side again moves outward and becomes separated from the row.
Left-side and right-side outward separations recur in alternating positions.
Near the end, a shiny ball is visible separated to the right of the row.
The support frame, black base, tabletop, and blue-and-black object do not visibly change position.
